{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin: your account balance, the active model's unit prices and a peak/off-peak indicator. / DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏插件：账号余额、当前模型档单价与峰谷时段指示灯。","id":"gh:1384463008","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-deepseek-usage","slug":"dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","plugin","usage"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin: your account balance, the active model's unit prices and a peak/off"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"-peak indicator. / DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏插件：账号余额、当前模型档单价与峰谷时段指示灯。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-deepseek-usage"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** sidebar plugin that shows, right in the DSH main window, how much money"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" or quota is left on the account behind the currently selected model, and what that model costs righ"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"t now — without leaving DSH. It supports nine providers."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"*Balance mode (DeepSeek, Kimi, Z.ai, OpenRouter…): the account balance, the current model's input / "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"cache / output unit prices, and the peak / off-peak indicator in the top-right corner.*"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"*Subscription mode (Kimi For Coding, OpenCode, MiniMax, Claude Code / Codex…): one D-shaped gauge pe"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"r usage window — the number in the middle is the remaining quota, the grey arc is what has been used"},{"id":"p6s3","text":", the green arc is what is left (red once 80% is used), and the badge names the window (`5H` = 5-hou"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"r, `7D` = weekly, `1M` = monthly).*"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What this plugin does"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"DSH lets you switch between many model providers, but each provider hides its account status on a di"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"fferent website. This plugin resolves the provider behind the model you have selected in DSH and put"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"s a live status card for that account at the bottom of the sidebar:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Account reading.** Two forms, depending on what the provider offers:
- *Balance providers* (Deep"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"Seek, Moonshot / Kimi, Z.ai, OpenRouter) publish the account balance, so the card shows it with its "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"currency symbol (`¥` / `$`).
- *Subscription providers* (Kimi For Coding, OpenCode, MiniMax, Claude "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"Code, OpenAI Codex) publish no balance, only usage windows. The card draws one gauge per window — 5-"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"hour, weekly, monthly, whatever the endpoint returns — and shows how much of each quota remains, tur"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ning red once 80% is used.
- The card always follows the selected model, so switching provider switc"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"hes the reading; no per-provider setup beyond the credential.
- **Unit prices of the current model.*"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"* The card lists input, input-cache and output prices for the billing period in effect right now, in"},{"id":"p9s9","text":" the provider's own currency. When a provider bills by time of day — DeepSeek's official peak / off-"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"peak schedule (Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time is peak, evenings, weekends and holi"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"days are off-peak) or OpenRouter's time-of-day pricing — an orange / green dot marks which window is"},{"id":"p9s12","text":" active, and hovering it shows the time left until the next switch.
## Installation and usage"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**Step 1 — configure the provider's credential.** The plugin queries each provider with the key you "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"already use for that provider: fill it on the **Models page in DSH**, or export it as an environment"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" variable (`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, `MOONSHOTAI_API_KEY`, `ZAI_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `KIMI_CODI"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"NG_API_KEY`, `OPENCODE_API_KEY`, `MINIMAX_API_KEY`, …). The `deepseek-account` route is the exceptio"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"n: it needs no key — sign in to DeepSeek inside DSH and the card reads that account grant."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Step 2 — install the plugin into the `web` profile:**"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Step 3 — restart `dsh web`** and open the URL it prints. The card sits at the bottom of the sideba"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"r, below the Cordis panel button; click it to refresh right away. Provider mappings and subscription"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" tokens are configured in **Settings → DeepSeek Usage**; when the route behind the selected model is"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" not supported, the card offers a **Set up mapping** button that opens that page directly."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Using a Claude Code / OpenAI Codex subscription (OAuth)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"An API key cannot read these subscriptions — they share an OAuth token instead. When DSH detects Cla"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ude Code or OpenAI Codex (or a provider mapping targets one of them), a token field appears in **Set"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"tings → DeepSeek Usage**, under the provider mappings. Paste the token there and the sidebar card st"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"arts reporting that subscription's remaining quota:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Claude Code** — on a machine signed in to Claude Code, copy `claudeAiOauth.accessToken` from `~/"},{"id":"p16s2","text":".claude/.credentials.json` (on macOS: the `Claude Code-credentials` keychain item). A token minted b"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"y `claude setup-token` also works.
- **OpenAI Codex** — copy `tokens.access_token` from `~/.codex/au"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"th.json` into the token field, and `tokens.account_id` into the account ID field."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Tokens are stored through DSH's credential service (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`) and never leave this"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" machine: no response, log line or page element carries one back. The **Clear** button removes them "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ne: no response, log line or page element carries one back. The **Clear** button removes them again."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Uninstall"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web`."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Supported DSH versions"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Use a plugin version that matches your DSH:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| DSH version | Plugin version to install |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| `0.2.x` (from `0.2.0-rc.1` on) | `0.11.0` or later |
| `0.1.x` (from `0.1.0-rc.6` on) | `0.10.x`, "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"or `0.11.0` or later |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Run `dsh --version` to check your DSH version. Installing without an explicit version picks the newe"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"st compatible release automatically; if the newest release does not match your DSH, pin an exact one"},{"id":"p25s3","text":", e.g. `@dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage@0.10.2`."}],"truncated":false}
